freeze_sha256_source_note: created and recorded BEFORE any newly produced MAIN_297 baseline outcome was inspected; all numbers at freeze time are pre-existing frozen RM-CSS/SIP/Agent MAIN_297 evidence only.

population.selection_rule: all 300 in frozen order minus the 3 Calibration-3 tasks

gold.role: observed change-set proxy, evaluation-only; Ground Truth is evaluation-only
gold.definition: file paths changed by the real commit (observed change-set proxy), repository-relative
gold.gold_normalization: repository-relative paths, forward slashes, as stored in the frozen proxies artifact
gold.checked: all 300 proxy path sets are subsets of the per-task frozen candidate universe (0 paths outside)

candidate_universe.normalization: repository-relative paths, forward slashes; path canonicalization = exact string as in candidate_universe records
candidate_universe.exclusions: NONE added by this protocol. The frozen universe artifact already encodes the canonical predicate (production .py only). No tests/migrations/generated/non-code exclusion is applied at scoring time beyond the frozen universe itself.
candidate_universe.predictions_outside_universe_policy: never silently dropped; counted in invalid_prediction_count and recorded per task
candidate_universe.duplicate_prediction_policy: duplicate paths deduplicated before set scoring (set semantics); count recorded in duplicate_prediction_count

evaluator.identity: benchmark.wp1a.scorer (per_task_confusion + ArmConfusion) and benchmark.wp1b.main_scoring pooled() — the exact evaluator used for RM-CSS / SIP / Agent MAIN_297 results

micro.definition: pooled confusion counts TP=sum(tp_t), FP=sum(fp_t), FN=sum(fn_t) over the 297 tasks

macro.definition: mean over tasks of the per-task metric, computed with the SAME frozen per-task convention (ArmConfusion per_task_confusion): per-task Precision=0 if TP+FP==0; per-task Recall=0 if TP+FN==0 (recorded convention); per-task F1=0 if 2TP+FP+FN==0

evaluator.size_metrics: mean, median, min, max of per-task selected-set size
evaluator.per_task_capability: per-task predictions and per-task confusion counts persisted so every aggregate can be recomputed

size_matched_rule: k_t = number of files selected by frozen RM-CSS prediction for task t (RM-CSS OUTPUT SIZE only; never reads gold); select top-k_t of the arm's ranking
oracle_label: UPPER_BOUND_ONLY / GOLD_SEEDED — diagnostic bridge to seeded change-impact methods (RIPPLE / From Seed to Scope); never placed in the direct competitor headline table

arm_A_BM25.query: exact developer change description received by RM-CSS = public/intent.json intent_text (same parent-visible text used by SIP and RM-CSS)
arm_A_BM25.documents: for each candidate file at the parent commit: file path + file content (doc = path + '\\n' + file content); file content = bytes of the file at parent commit decoded utf-8 errors=replace; missing file at parent -> empty text (fail-closed deterministic)
arm_A_BM25.document_source: frozen upstream cache repo (dist/pilot-repo-cache/saleor, 22,615 commits) via git show <parent>:<path> — the same cache the frozen MAIN_297 agent materialization used
arm_A_BM25.tokenizer: benchmark.cheap_baselines.tokenize (deterministic: snake_case/camelCase boundary split, lowercased, alphanumeric only, frozen stopword list) — implementation recorded in src/benchmark/cheap_baselines/tokenize.py
arm_A_BM25.tuning: NONE. Parameters owner pre-specified; no k selected after seeing outcomes; all of BM25@1/3/5/10 reported
arm_A_BM25.tie_break: score descending, then normalized repository path ascending (frozen Route-B / SweRank convention)

arm_B_DENSE.source: already-existing frozen dense path — qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b @ DeepInfra, realization A, frozen splitter + MAX-cosine aggregation — artifacts research/saleor-reserve-300-rmcss/full_file_scores_saleor300.parquet (frozen per-task dense_file_score + dense_rank over the frozen candidate universe)
arm_B_DENSE.model_checkpoint: qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b (DeepInfra), frozen in the RM-CSS Saleor RESERVE-300 realization A ledger
arm_B_DENSE.tokenizer_chunking_aggregation: frozen splitter into code units (benchmark.signal.code_units.extract_code_units) + score(file) = MAX cosine over units (benchmark.signal.swrank_adapter.aggregate_file_score) — same frozen dense representation consumed by the frozen RM-CSS classifier (feature dense_file_score)
arm_B_DENSE.query: intent_text of the task (query_sha256 in the artifact equals the frozen intent_sha256 for every task)
arm_B_DENSE.ranking: dense_file_score descending; NaN dense scores (no embeddable units) rank below all finite scores; tie-break path ascending
arm_B_DENSE.download_policy: NO new model download >100 MiB is permitted; if the frozen SweRankEmbed-Small path were required instead and not cached locally it is BLOCKED_DOWNLOAD — the frozen qwen dense artifact path above requires no download and no new API call
arm_B_DENSE.ablation_label: DENSE_ONLY_ABLATION (RM-CSS's calibrated classifier consumes exactly this dense representation; the arm isolates retrieval quality without the calibrated head)

arm_C_CIA.implementation: frozen static reverse-dependency/impact closure as implemented in scripts/classical_cia_baseline_v1.py (_adjacency undirected over the per-task frozen dependency_graph.json edges; CIA_1HOP = seed + 1-hop closure; CIA_2HOP = seed + 2-hop budgeted propagation)
arm_C_CIA.graph_source: per-task public/dependency_graph.json (frozen parent-only AST import graph)
arm_C_CIA.c_realistic_seed: BM25 top-1 prediction for the same task (same-protocol seed; no gold)
arm_C_CIA.c_oracle_seed_rule: lexicographically first gold changed non-test file under the deterministic frozen normalization rule = min(sorted(gold paths intersect candidate universe)); tests are already outside the frozen universe so no extra test rule is needed

arm_D_AGENT.mode: READ-ONLY reuse of the frozen bounded Repository Agent MAIN_297 result (research/wp1b/main-297-2026-09-22/wp1b_agent_predictions.json + .sha256)

arm_E_SIP_RMCSS.mode: READ-ONLY reuse of frozen SIP / RM-CSS MAIN_297 evidence (research/wp1a/sip_rmcss_per_task_predictions.json + .sha256; model identity qwen/qwen3-coder @ deepinfra/turbo for SIP, deterministic L2-LR classifier for RM-CSS)

paired_statistics.method: paired cluster bootstrap over TASKS (task is the resampling unit)
paired_statistics.draw_algorithm: same as benchmark.wp1b.main_scoring.bootstrap_indices: random.Random(seed).randrange(n) per drawn index
paired_statistics.per_sample: resample 297 task indices with replacement; recompute pooled micro confusion counts (TP/FP/FN) per arm over the sampled tasks; recompute micro F1 and micro Recall per arm from those counts
paired_statistics.statistics: DeltaF1 = F1_micro(RM-CSS) - F1_micro(baseline); DeltaRecall = Recall(RM-CSS) - Recall(baseline)
paired_statistics.ci: 95% percentile CI [q025, q975] of the delta distribution
paired_statistics.comparisons: RM-CSS vs EVERY pre-specified direct headline variant (BM25@1/3/5/10, DENSE@1/3/5/10); SIZE_MATCHED controls receive the same bootstrap analysis but are reported as controlled analyses; no significance chasing, no post-hoc deletion
paired_statistics.point_estimates: raw pooled deltas on the full 297-task population

efficiency_reporting.note: zero-API arms: API calls = 0 and API cost USD = 0 for NEW calls; computational cost is NOT zero — wall time and compute context are recorded; frozen dense artifact reuse carries its historical materialization cost (recorded informational: embedding_cost_usd_total 0.026035 for 300 tasks) which is NOT this mission's spend

published_context_only.rule: published Acc@K / Hit@K / MRR / MAP / function-method-level accuracy / resolve rate MUST NOT be numerically compared as if they were our MAIN_297 micro-F1; any such numbers in the report are labeled PUBLISHED_CONTEXT_ONLY

ripple_positioning.protocol_implication: RIPPLE / From Seed to Scope is a SEEDED change-impact method; an experiment giving it a gold changed file is GOLD_SEEDED + UPPER_BOUND_ONLY, never DIRECT_SAME_PROTOCOL against description-only RM-CSS; a fair future comparison requires a separately frozen seed-generation protocol (e.g. BM25 top-1)

no_retuning_no_feedback.feedback: baseline outcomes are NOT fed back into RM-CSS design or tuning; no k/hops/models/normalization is chosen after seeing outcomes

stop_conditions: unexpected modification of frozen RM-CSS/SIP/Agent evidence
